# Packaging and Reconstructionsvg image

Relevant source files

- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md)

## Purpose and Scopesvg image

This document explains the core bidirectional workflow of Contexter: converting directory structures into single-file context representations (packaging) and reversing this process to rebuild projects (reconstruction). This workflow enables project portability, AI model integration, and simplified project sharing.

For command-specific usage details, see [Command Reference](/ray0404/Contexter/5-command-reference). For context file format specifications, see [Markdown Context Format](/ray0404/Contexter/7.1-markdown-context-format) and [HTML Context Format](/ray0404/Contexter/7.2-html-context-format). For update workflows that build on these operations, see [Update Management](/ray0404/Contexter/3.3-update-management).

---

## Bidirectional Workflow Overviewsvg image

The packaging and reconstruction operations form a complete round-trip workflow where information is preserved across transformations.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md1-61](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L1-L61) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py39-53](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L39-L53)

---

## Packaging: Directory to Context Filesvg image

Packaging aggregates all project files into a single text file with embedded metadata about file paths, directory structure, and content.

### Command-to-Module Mappingsvg image

| Command | Module | Entry Point | Output Format |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `buildcontext` | `context_builder.py` | `main()` | Markdown (.md) |
| `buildcontexthtml` | `build_context_html.py` | `main()` | HTML (.html) |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py40-49](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L40-L49)

### Markdown Packaging Processsvg image

The `context_builder.py` module implements the Markdown packaging workflow.

**Key Functions in context\_builder.py:**

| Function | Lines | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `main()` | [svg imagecontext\_builder.py50-72](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L50-L72) | Entry point, argument parsing, orchestration |
| `process_path_for_md()` | [svg imagecontext\_builder.py11-49](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L11-L49) | Recursive processing of paths, duplicate detection |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py1-74](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L1-L74)

### Output Structure (Markdown)svg image

The generated Markdown context file follows this structure:

```px-2
--- DIRECTORY STRUCTURE: <dirname> ---
```

````

--- FILE:  ---

```px-2
<file content>
```

--- FILE:  ---
...

```px-2
**Key Characteristics:**
- **Delimiter**: `--- FILE: <path> ---` marks file boundaries
- **Directory Structure**: Embedded tree view at the beginning
- **Code Fences**: Language-specific syntax highlighting via ` ````<lang> `
- **Binary Handling**: `--- SKIPPED (BINARY): <path> ---` for binary files

**Sources:** <FileRef file-url="https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L25-L45" min=25 max=45 file-path="context_builder.py">Hii</FileRef>

### Processing Logic Details

```mermaid
graph TB
    INPUT["Input: path"]
    NORMALIZE["os.path.normpath(path)"]
    DUPE_CHECK{"path in processed_files?"}
    SKIP1["Return (skip)"]
    ADD["processed_files.add(path)"]
    
    TYPE{"os.path type?"}
    
    subgraph "Directory Logic"
        TOP_LEVEL{"First directory?"}
        GEN_TREE["generate_file_tree()<br/>(contexter_utils)"]
        OSWALK["os.walk(norm_path)"]
        SORT_FILTER["Sort and filter by<br/>exclude_patterns"]
        RECURSIVE["Recurse on files"]
    end
    
    subgraph "File Logic"
        BIN_CHECK["is_binary()<br/>(contexter_utils)"]
        BIN_RESULT{"Binary?"}
        WRITE_SKIP["Write SKIPPED marker"]
        READ_FILE["Read with UTF-8"]
        GET_LANG["get_language_from_path()<br/>(contexter_utils)"]
        WRITE_CONTENT["Write FILE marker<br/>+ fenced code block"]
    end
    
    INPUT --> NORMALIZE
    NORMALIZE --> DUPE_CHECK
    DUPE_CHECK -->|"yes"| SKIP1
    DUPE_CHECK -->|"no"| ADD
    ADD --> TYPE
    
    TYPE -->|"directory"| TOP_LEVEL
    TOP_LEVEL -->|"yes"| GEN_TREE
    TOP_LEVEL -->|"no"| OSWALK
    GEN_TREE --> OSWALK
    OSWALK --> SORT_FILTER
    SORT_FILTER --> RECURSIVE
    
    TYPE -->|"file"| BIN_CHECK
    BIN_CHECK --> BIN_RESULT
    BIN_RESULT -->|"yes"| WRITE_SKIP
    BIN_RESULT -->|"no"| READ_FILE
    READ_FILE --> GET_LANG
    GET_LANG --> WRITE_CONTENT
```

**Duplicate Prevention:** The `processed_files` set tracks normalized paths to avoid processing the same file multiple times ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py13-17](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L13-L17)).

**Exclusion Filtering:** Uses `fnmatch` pattern matching against `DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS` plus user-provided patterns ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py29-68](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L29-L68)).

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py11-49](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L11-L49) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter\_utils.py](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter_utils.py)

## Reconstruction: Context File to Directorysvg image

Reconstruction parses context files and recreates the original directory structure by writing individual files.

### Command-to-Module Mappingsvg image

| Command | Module | Entry Point | Input Format |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reconstructor` | `reconstructor.py` | `main()` | Markdown (.md) |
| `reconstructorhtml` | `reconstructor_html.py` | `main()` | HTML (.html) |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py42-50](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L42-L50)

### Reconstruction Workflowsvg image

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py42-50](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L42-L50) based on system architecture

### Parsing Logic (Markdown)svg image

The Markdown reconstructor uses delimiter-based parsing:

1. **Scan for Markers**: Locate all `--- FILE: <path> ---` delimiters
2. **Extract Content**: Capture code fence content between markers
3. **Remove Fences**: Strip  ````` ````<lang> ````` and ````` ```` ````` wrapper
4. **Map Paths**: Associate extracted content with file paths

**Key Pattern Recognition:**

- Start: `--- FILE: <path> ---`
- Content: Between  ````` ````<lang> ````` and ````` ```` `````
- Skip: `--- SKIPPED (BINARY): <path> ---`

**Sources:** Based on packaging format in [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py38-45](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L38-L45)

### File Writing Processsvg image

**Directory Creation:** Reconstruction creates all necessary parent directories automatically using `os.makedirs(exist_ok=True)`.

**Binary Handling:** Files marked as binary during packaging are not recreated during reconstruction.

**Sources:** Based on inverse operations of [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py11-49](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L11-L49)

---

## File Processing Componentssvg image

Both packaging and reconstruction rely on shared utilities from `contexter_utils.py`.

### Utility Function Mappingsvg image

**Key Utilities:**

| Function | Purpose | Used In |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `is_binary()` | Identifies binary files by checking for null bytes | Packaging |
| `generate_file_tree()` | Generates ASCII directory tree representation | Packaging (Markdown) |
| `get_language_from_path()` | Maps file extensions to syntax highlighting language codes | Packaging |
| `DEFAULT_EXCLUDE_PATTERNS` | List of common exclusion patterns (e.g., `.git/`, `__pycache__/`, `*.pyc`) | Packaging |

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py7-9](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L7-L9) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md24-35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L24-L35)

## Format-Specific Considerationssvg image

### Markdown Formatsvg image

**Advantages:**

- Human-readable in plain text editors
- Version control friendly (meaningful diffs)
- Direct AI model compatibility
- Syntax highlighting support via Pygments

**Limitations:**

- Requires code fence parsing for reconstruction
- Sensitive to formatting in code content (triple backticks in code must be escaped)

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md3-26](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L3-L26)

### HTML Formatsvg image

**Advantages:**

- Styled viewing in web browsers
- Potentially better for documentation/sharing
- Standardized DOM structure for parsing

**Limitations:**

- Less human-readable as plain text
- More verbose file size
- Requires HTML parser for reconstruction

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md30-31](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L30-L31) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)setup.py49-50](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/setup.py#L49-L50)

### Bidirectional Guaranteessvg image

Both formats preserve:

- **File paths**: Exact relative paths from source directory
- **File content**: Complete text content (UTF-8)
- **Directory structure**: Hierarchical organization
- **Binary detection**: Markers for non-text files

Both formats do **not** preserve:

- **Binary file content**: Only markers are written
- **File permissions**: Not captured in context files
- **Timestamps**: No metadata about creation/modification times
- **Symlinks**: Followed during packaging, not preserved

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)context\_builder.py36-39](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/context_builder.py#L36-L39)

## Related Operationssvg image

The packaging and reconstruction operations integrate with other Contexter workflows:

- **Sanitization**: The `sanitizecontext` command fixes malformed context files before reconstruction (see [AI Integration Workflow](/ray0404/Contexter/4.2-ai-integration-workflow))
- **Updates**: The `updatecontext` and `smartupdate` commands generate patches between context file versions (see [Update Management](/ray0404/Contexter/3.3-update-management))
- **Conversion**: The `md2html` and `html2md` commands enable format migration (see [Format Conversion Workflow](/ray0404/Contexter/4.4-format-conversion-workflow))

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md22-35](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L22-L35)
